title: I love this shower curtain
text: I love this shower curtain. I love the colors of this shower curtain.  It really brightens up my bathroom. I don't care for the plastic hooks, I already have my own shower curtain hooks.  I got this for the curtain, not the cheap hooks.  I love it!
